provenance_assessment.declaration_summary: Original author states all project work and commits were made during the hackathon with no prior-project code reused.
provenance_assessment.reason: The reviewed working copy has no .git directory or original commit history. Authorship dates and prior-code origin cannot be established independently from this copy.

implementation_choices_not_event_require: Retain evidence for all evaluation runs, including errors and worse results.
Keep runtime model calls limited to Meta models and disclose development assistance.
Keep generated diffs review-only and never apply or execute them automatically.
Prepare a concise video and an accessible reproducible repository, then confirm actual submission requirements.
Do not claim bonus eligibility or complete rules compliance until participant-specific conditions are verified.
